title: How to Use Dermalogica Deep Breakout Liquid Patch (5% Sulfur) #shorts
description:

• Apply as soon as you feel a blemish forming, to help stop breakouts before you can even see them (14 ml)

• Dab a rice-sized amount on deep breakouts, rub in until invisible, allow one minute to dry down, repeat as needed
